LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Novice_1: {PAWN} swept a stretch of ruins for salvage, keeping to cover and avoiding anything that looked hungry.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Novice_2: {PAWN} logged a quiet patrol - a few scavvers scattered at the sight of the armor, nothing worth a report back to Lost Hills.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Novice_3: {PAWN} picked through a collapsed pre-War structure, filling a pack with whatever hadn't rusted through.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Novice_4: {PAWN} walked the perimeter, charted a few new landmarks, and came back with dust in every seam of the armor.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Veteran_1: {PAWN} cleared out a nest of raiders holed up in an old maintenance depot and stripped it of anything the Brotherhood could use.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Veteran_2: {PAWN} tracked down a rumored tech cache, fought off a pack of ferals guarding the entrance, and hauled out what was left intact.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the trip mapping an old highway network, marking safe routes for future caravans.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back limping but standing, a busted pre-War terminal slung over one shoulder.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a squad would've drawn too much attention, and came out the other side with the mission done.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the deep strike exactly as planned - in, secure the objective, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks in hostile territory and returned with intel Lost Hills will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just handed over the recovered tech and asked for a debrief later.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any Brotherhood map, charting ground no chapter has set foot on in living memory.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from the unmapped wastes with a full report and coordinates worth sending a proper expedition to follow up on.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact, and returned with word of something out there worth the Brotherhood's attention.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into the chapter looking like the wasteland itself, carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map.
